title: ServiceIdentity
description: Service-to-service identity for inter-OS communication. Identifies the calling system and its authorized context. Reconciled in E4.1 against Account Again's actual runtime (account_again/models/service_identity.py) — pre-freeze v2.1.0 correction. Transport authentication mechanics (binding this domain object to a cryptographic caller identity) remain an E5 concern (see E5_IDENTITY_AND_SERVICE_AUTH.md); this schema describes the domain record only.

serviceIdentityId.description: Unique identifier for this service identity record.

systemId.description: Specialist OS this identity represents. RUNTIME_CORRECT_SCHEMA_WRONG finding from E4.1: the prior schema used field name `callingSystem` with lowercase-kebab enum values (e.g. `conductor-main`); the real runtime (VALID_SYSTEM_IDS in account_again/models/service_identity.py) has always used `systemId` with SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE values, and every E3/E4 test and API call uses that shape.

tenantId.description: Tenant this service identity is scoped to, if tenant-bound. Null means the identity may act across tenants at the transport level (domain-level tenant checks on the specific resource being accessed still apply — see EntitlementDecision/CredentialRef).

status.description: Current status. RUNTIME_CORRECT_SCHEMA_WRONG finding: the prior schema had no status field at all, despite REVOKED being a core, tested runtime state (revoked service identities are rejected by the entitlement engine).

allowedCapabilities.description: AI capabilities this service identity is authorized to request. Empty array means unconstrained by this field (constraint is enforced via AIEntitlement, not here, in the current runtime).

correlationId.description: Correlation ID linking to the business/AI-execution flow, if this identity assertion is being referenced from a specific request rather than looked up standalone.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this service identity was created. RUNTIME_CORRECT_SCHEMA_WRONG finding: the prior schema used `issuedAt`; the real field is `createdAt`.

revokedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this service identity was revoked, if REVOKED.
